sections.title: Resilience through Low Operational Costs
sections.body: Financial sustainability in the data center industry is won or lost on operational efficiency. In our 'Conservative Scenario,' we assume an average utilization rate of just 45% and a continued decline in global GPU rental prices. Even in this environment, our $0.04/kWh energy arbitrage ensures the project remains cash-flow positive from the first year of full 1MW operation. Our 'Base Case' (55% utilization) targets an EBITDA of 35-50%, reflecting a steady demand from DePIN networks and enterprise cloud users in East Africa. For investors, this represents an infrastructure-grade asset with the growth profile of a tech company. The risk of 'empty racks' is mitigated by our protocol partnerships, which act as a global buyer of last resort for every watt of power we generate. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
